instruction: Add a new habit tracking log note for today in my Simple Note account. It should be the same as yesterday, except I ate home-prepared meals today.
notes: Single-app task (simple_note). The agent must discover yesterday's habit-tracking log note via search_notes, read its full title/content/tags/pinned via show_note, then create a new note for today (2023-05-18) that copies yesterday's title format, tags, pinned flag and content, changing only the 'ate home-prepared meals' entry to done. The static predicate today-version ties the create_note arguments to the looked-up source note so the planner must read the source before creating. create_note carries the created record and the source note as extra non-API parameters; supervisor-complete-task takes the created note record as a non-API parameter so its precondition equals the task-specific goal. No answer is required since the task is not a question.

plan: (simple-note-create-note title-habit-log-2023-05-18 content-habit-log-2023-05-18-home-prepared-meals simple-note-token tags-habit-log pinned-as-yesterday today-habit-note yesterday-habit-note)
